content_sections.heading: Post-wise Details
content_sections.text: Qualification required: Holding analogous post on regular basis, or 3 years regular service in pay scale 5500-9000 (pre-revised), or 5 years in 5000-8000 (pre-revised); Graduate from a recognized University; three years experience in legal matters; knowledge of computer applications. Experience required: Three years experience in legal matters; and holding analogous post on regular basis, or 3 years regular service in the post in the pay scale of 5500-9000 (pre-revised), or 5 years regular service in the posts in the pay scale of 5000-8000 (pre-revised) or equivalent. Age limit: Maximum 56 years. Pay: Level 07 in the Pay Matrix of Rs. 44900-142400. Qualification required: Holding analogous post on regular basis, or 3 years regular service in pay scale 5000-8000 (pre-revised), or 5 years in 4000-6000 (pre-revised); Graduation with Statistics/Mathematics/Economics as main subject; 3 years experience in collection, compilation and analysis of data; knowledge of computer applications and data processing. Experience required: 3 years' experience in collection, compilation and analysis of data in Central/State Government/UT Administration/PSUs/Autonomous Organizations; and holding analogous post on regular basis, or 3 years regular service in pay scale 5000-8000 (pre-revised), or 5 years regular service in pay scale 4000-6000 (pre-revised) or equivalent. Age limit: Maximum 56 years. Pay: Level 06 in the Pay Matrix of Rs. 35400-112400. Qualification required: Graduate in Commerce from a recognized University with five years' experience of accounting work in Central Government/State Government/UT/PSU/Autonomous Organizations; OR Graduation with Cash and Accounts Course from ISTM, DOP&T or Subordinate Accounts Service (S.A.S.) examination or an equivalent course; Knowledge of computer applications and data processing. Experience required: Holding analogous post on regular basis, or 3 years regular service in the post in pay scale Rs. 5000-8000 (pre-revised), or 5 years regular service in pay scale Rs. 4000-6000 (pre-revised) or equivalent. Age limit: Maximum 56 years. Pay: Level 06 in the Pay Matrix of Rs. 35400-112400.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for CCPD Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the organisation by 17 December 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in CCPD Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 3 vacancies: 1 Desk Officer, 1 Research Assistant, 1 Accountant.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for CCPD Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Fill in the application form (Table-II (Application form for the Deputation Post) in this notice) and send it to Desk Officer, Office of the Chief Commissioner for Persons with Disabilities, 5th Floor, NISD Building, Plot No.G-2, Sector-10, Dwarka, New Delhi-110075, by through proper channel, to reach by 17 December 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age is 56 years (as on the closing date for receipt of applications).

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: It depends on the post: Level 07 in the Pay Matrix of Rs. 44900-142400 for Desk Officer, Level 06 in the Pay Matrix of Rs. 35400-112400 for Research Assistant, Level 06 in the Pay Matrix of Rs. 35400-112400 for Accountant.

faq.question: Q6. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Officers of Central/State Government, UT, PSUs or Autonomous Organizations holding an analogous post or with the required regular service. Desk Officer: Graduate with three years experience in legal matters. Research Assistant: Graduation with Statistics/Mathematics/Economics and 3 years data experience. Accountant: Graduate in Commerce with five years accounting experience, or Graduation with ISTM Cash and Accounts Course or SAS examination. Computer knowledge for all. The requirement for each post is in the eligibility table above.

faq.question: Q7. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Applicants must be working in Central Government/State Government/Union Territory/Public Sector Undertakings/Autonomous Organizations. Applicants must be able to be relieved immediately on selection and be free from vigilance angle. Officers under Central/State Governments are only eligible for Absorption. Candidates of non-Government Organizations are eligible only for Short Term Contract.

faq.question: Q8. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Deputation (including short-term contract) in another ex-cadre post held immediately preceding this appointment shall ordinarily not exceed 3 years.

faq.question: Q9. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Information in the application, supported by documents on essential qualification/work experience, will be assessed by the Selection Committee at the time of selection.

faq.question: Q10. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Deputation governed by DoPT O.M. No. 6/8/2009-Estt. (Pay-II) dated 17.06.2010 and the provisions in the Recruitment Rules. Posts filled by deputation (including short-term contract)/absorption.
